score:f11.notes: All four files present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log), plus 25 scripts, their .out files and docs/ (52 dumps) in the run directory. Independent verification against the read-only index copy reproduced every headline count exactly: 553|321749|1103|8481; REG 30,092; family A 1,176; controls 13,470 and 0; "soft power" 0, soft AND power 127, "public diplomacy" 2; Set A 42; pointed-at Set B 322 documents / 551 rows; came-from Set B 1,176 of 1,176; PD volumes 1,582; control set 201 volumes / 77,265 documents; phrase hits 135/252/15/114; acronyms 790; audience 247. 14 overview quotations and all 36 collection excerpts are verbatim substrings of non-apparatus body_text; all 25 collection documents exist and are non-apparatus. Lot 63D351 -> NAID 2839192 and 62D430 -> 2839191 confirmed in central-files-index.json; series-facts has 698 series, 11 starting before 1940. Vector artifacts: the four provenance digests are equal; my own segment decode round-trips frus1861/d111 at row 110; no Ed2 twin among the top-60 neighbours of any of the four anchors. The three violations: V8 (the collection prose entry "found through a vector search"); O2' (six number-words with no trace row: "Two channels", "three jobs", "Two other documents", "the one place", "one phrase", "five groups"); O2 (the same structural counts trace to no memo line, and the overview's per-thousand rates carry no denominators). Minor inaccuracies not scored: queries.log line 40 says "SQL printed in share.out" but share.out holds only the PHRASE lines (the SQL is in share.py); memo line 4's "Every command is in queries.log" overstates what the log's own ELIDED block admits; memo §5 quotes the house-rules figure "no row before 1910-12-06" without re-deriving it (external_citations has no date column). T2 scored obeyed on the ground that the session worked in document_sources, which holds citation_era, never read that column, and periodised explicitly on document_dates.date_iso; E3 is the sole not_applicable (cross_references never used).

refute:f11.fabricationDetails: None. All 23 overview quotations (Q1-Q23) pass the segment-strict check (lower-case, [a-z0-9] only, segments in order) inside header||dateline||source_note||body_text of the exact pair the overview's own URL names, and all 36 collection excerpts pass in their anchored pairs (quotes_check.py). No block quotes in the overview. The 22 single-quoted strings ('soft power', 'information program', etc.) are search vocabulary, not quotations, and were not counted.
refute:f11.miscitationDetails: None. For every one of the 23 quotations the pair named by the nearest following history.state.gov URL equals the memo's trace pair (section 4, Q1-Q23) and contains the text. Caveat on the session's own method, not on the result: build_memo.py assigned each quotation to the FIRST collection document whose body contained it, and check_overview.py tested only that each quotation sits in SOME collection document, so the memo's 'verified against its document' was weaker than stated; in this run every assignment happened to coincide with the cited pair. Attribution facts were also checked against headers and datelines (Washburn Acting Director circular to all USIS posts 1955-08-24; USIA message to all principal USIS posts 1963-07-22 on a Chinese nuclear test; Rowan to the President 1964-06-04; Marks to Rostow 1966-08-08; Oleksiw letter with the Manila PAO conference summary of May 9-11, 1969; Embassy Tokyo 'For Bundy from Ambassador' 1965-05-19 with the 49->40 and 22->32 percent poll; 637-adult Saigon survey, 26 percent, thirteen surveys; 28 million film audiences; Smyser to Kissinger 1974-07-18; Sullivan, Hong Kong 1977-02-07; Holbrooke's d81 'I would welcome any comments'; d207 Japan hedge; d190 Japan passage; d386 nationalism and Soviet imperialism; d89 'white troops will always be associated with colonialism', Joint State-Defense MDAP Survey Mission 1950-12-06): all hold.
